frontier.next_probe: Bisect maspsx's input (the raw cc1 .s output piped from the compile.sh chain) to find which line/gate-list entry triggers the unpack exception; compare against a known-working nonmatchings/ import for a different function (e.g. tmp/grind/func_80056CB8/s4/perm_ws referenced in the campaign status output, which launched successfully) to see what differs about this function's TU-scoped gate memberships.
